subtitle: Lesson 4 · Chapter 1: First Look at the Files

code:
aws glue create-database \
  --database-input '{"Name": "northfield_raw_db",
  "Description": "Raw, uncataloged Northfield exports"}'
caption: A logical namespace for table metadata — not a running database engine.

code:
aws glue create-crawler \
  --name northfield-orders-raw-crawler \
  --role AWSGlueServiceRole-NorthfieldCapstone \
  --database-name northfield_raw_db \
  --targets '{"S3Targets":[{"Path":
    "s3://northfield-raw-zone/orders-raw/"}]}'

aws glue start-crawler \
  --name northfield-orders-raw-crawler
caption: Starting -> Running -> Stopping -> Ready. Under a minute for 31 small files.
